rouletteSeconds.description: HUD balloon roulette length after a pickup

chargeMultiplier.description: Triple Fizz: drift charge rate scale while active

weightBonus.description: Bubble: added to weight while held

trailable.description: Hold the button to trail it behind as a rear shield; let go to use it (MKW drag)

hits.description: Wind-Up Mouse: karts it can bump before it runs down

weave.description: Wind-Up Mouse: weave amplitude, fraction of the free road half width

range.description: Grapple Anchor: metres ahead along the road it can hook

releaseMetres.description: Grapple Anchor: the pull lets go this close and slingshots

slingshotSeconds.description: Grapple Anchor: item boost on release

burstRadius.description: Strike Ball: the closing STRIKE burst spins karts inside it

slamRadius.description: Pogo Spring: the slam's shock ring

popSpeed.description: Strike Ball: m/s up given to a kart it knocks, so it flies like a pin

hitEffect.description: What landing this item does to the victim. Omit for items that never hit.

table.description: Weights per position (1-based index into the array). Missing items weigh 0.

ownerGraceSeconds.description: A kart cannot be hit by its own projectile or drop for this long after firing (turbo-kart-rush OWNER_GRACE)

spawnAheadMetres.description: Projectiles spawn this far ahead (or behind) of the kart

dropBehindMetres.description: Ground items land this far behind the kart; past kartRadius + the widest ground radius (0.85 + 1.2) so a parked kart never sits on its own drop

projectileHeight.description: Metres above the road a projectile flies

homingSnapDistance.description: Metres from its target at which the Homing Kite leaves the centreline for the target's lateral

homingLateralRate.description: m/s the Kite can move sideways while snapping

maxGroundPerOwner.description: A further drop pops the owner's oldest ground item

trailBehindMetres.description: A trailed item rides this far behind the kart centre (past kartRadius + the item radius)

hitHeight.description: A kart whose ground clearance is more than this passes over projectiles and ground items (Pogo Spring)
